baseline_models.focus_anchor: يعلم / تحمل / تغيض الأرحام / تزداد / بمقدار
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge penetrates the hidden carrier and tracks bidirectional change inside the womb against an exact bound; the measure is therefore a live account of variation, not only a final total.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower makes concealed gestational states epistemically present.
The inward pregnancy or fruit supplies the carried content being tracked.
Decrease supplies one direction of change within the carrier.
The female womb supplies the bounded inner site of growth.
Growth and addition supply the counter-direction to decrease.
A quantity reaching its limit makes every changing state measurable.

changed_reading.before: God knows pregnancies and their outcomes.
changed_reading.after: God knows pregnancy as a continuously varying hidden process, including every decrement, increment, and bounded state before outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كل أنثى / كل شيء / عنده / بمقدار
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled universal encloses carrier and thing alike; proximity with God and calibrated fit turn the verse into an exhaustive register in which no minute state falls outside placement or measure.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion binds every female and every thing into one scope.
Anything knowable and reportable supplies the unrestricted unit of the register.
Nearness and presence make the measured particulars available rather than remote.
Fit to an appropriate measure assigns each particular its exact calibrated place.

changed_reading.before: Everything has a fixed amount known to God.
changed_reading.after: Every particular, including each hidden reproductive fluctuation, is present within an exhaustive and exactly fitted divine register.

baseline_models.mechanism: The anatomical womb remains primary, while the same root opens into mercy and kinship and the female branch into fertile receptivity; gestation can therefore be carried as the material origin of a relational field.

activation_trace.role: Fertile receptive ground extends the female carrier into a generative image.
Inner pregnancy and fruit keep the generative reading anchored in literal carrying.
The anatomical womb remains the controlling referent.
Mercy and tenderness supply an affective relation generated around the womb.
Kinship supplies the social network issuing from reproductive origin.

changed_reading.before: Wombs are biological containers whose contents are known.
changed_reading.after: The biological womb is also the seed-site of mercy and kinship, so its measured changes can be read as generating relations as well as bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured gestational change becomes a managed trajectory: movement runs toward a temporal limit, management looks to its outcome, and the term is entered as an obligating record.

activation_trace.role: The focus measure supplies the bounded quantity to be temporalized.
Flowing movement turns a measure into a trajectory rather than a snapshot.
A fixed duration gives the trajectory an endpoint.
Management by considering consequences supplies purposive ordering through time.
The later repeated term confirms temporal boundedness.
An inscription that establishes rule or decree turns the term into a recorded allocation.

structural_cues: The context brackets 13:8 with each body running to a named term in 13:2 and every term having a book in 13:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, fixed term, outcome-aware management, and recorded decree; I infer that prenatal quantities are time-indexed trajectories. A live alternative is that the temporal language governs only celestial and prophetic schedules, merely analogizing gestation.

changed_reading.before: Measure is the exact quantity of a hidden state.
changed_reading.after: Measure includes the changing state’s scheduled course, endpoint, and recorded temporal allocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The female carrier and inward fruit are reframed as a generative ecology: fertile ground receives a shared input, channels it internally, and produces differentiated increase and fruit under measure.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground is the focus-side bridge from female carrier to generative matrix.
Pregnancy and fruit join bodily and vegetal production without replacing either.
Growth supplies the variable yield inside the matrix.
Mature fruit makes the carried pregnancy legible as an eventual yield.
Soft productive earth supplies the material analogue for fertile receptivity.
A share and channel of irrigation supplies differentiated internal delivery.
Male fluid in the womb directly crosses the common-water image into reproduction.
Surplus and remainder explain unequal increase from a common input.

structural_cues: The paired fruits of 13:3 and neighboring plots of 13:4 precede the focus and stress different yields despite one water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile earth, fruit, irrigation shares, womb-fluid, and differential surplus; I infer a common generative mechanism across field and womb. The alternative is a loose agricultural analogy that should not broaden every female into land.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories variation inside individual pregnancies.
changed_reading.after: It also presents gestation as one instance of measured generative ecology, where common inputs become differentiated hidden growth and fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concealed womb is placed on a disclosure path: unseen and inward states pass through internal change toward visible emergence at childbirth, while divine knowledge spans both phases without information loss.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure spans the hidden and manifest phases.
The inward pregnancy supplies the initially concealed state.
The womb supplies the hidden chamber from which emergence occurs.
Concealment from eyes names the prenatal epistemic phase.
Emergence at childbirth gives the witnessed phase a specifically reproductive edge.
Inward hiding reinforces the concealed side of the passage.
Visible appearance supplies the public side of emergence.
Covering and hiddenness keep the contrast anchored in concealment.
Childbirth and postpartum blood turn inner change into bodily exit.

structural_cues: Immediately after 13:8, 13:9-10 moves from unseen to witnessed and secret to open; 13:11 then repeats change inside selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed versus witnessed states, a childbirth branch, and inner change; I infer a developmental passage from gestation to birth. The live alternative is a general claim about omniscience with no staged obstetric sequence.

changed_reading.before: God sees a hidden pregnancy as clearly as a visible fact.
changed_reading.after: God continuously knows the whole transition from concealed gestational variation through internal change to witnessed childbirth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cloud, water, valley, and carrier form a material transfer system: a heavy carrier releases into channels sized by measure, while hidden basins and water vessels sharpen the womb as a regulated reservoir with variable contents.

activation_trace.role: A cloud carrying abundant water bridges pregnancy to the later heavy-cloud carrier.
A sunken hidden water-collection place turns decrement into reservoir drawdown.
The split-root water vessel gives increase a contained-fluid image.
The moving cloud supplies the external carrier in the analogy.
A burdened load makes the cloud’s heaviness function like carrying.
Literal water supplies the transferred material.
Torrent flow supplies movement between carrier and channel.
A valley as torrent-channel supplies a capacity-shaped receiving path.
Each valley’s measure explicitly controls the amount carried through it.
The torrent visibly bearing material externalizes the focus’s hidden carrying.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence moves from heavy clouds in 13:12 to water, capacity-sized valleys, and a carrying torrent in 13:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water-bearing carriers, hidden collection, vessel, channel, and measured flow; I infer a reservoir model for womb change. The alternative is a material analogy only, with no claim that gestation is hydraulically described.

changed_reading.before: The womb is a static container whose content rises or falls.
changed_reading.after: The womb can be imagined as a measured reservoir within a transfer system, with capacity, inflow, carriage, retention, and drawdown.

context_deltas.mechanism: The womb’s kinship branch unfolds into spouses and dispersed descendants, then into the opposed social acts of joining affiliation and severing connection; biological carrying generates obligations extending beyond birth.

activation_trace.role: The anatomical womb keeps the social reading rooted in reproduction.
Near kinship converts bodily origin into an enduring relation.
The carried child’s lineage makes descent and affiliation a live issue.
Marriage supplies the paired relation around which descent forms.
Smallness and dispersal image descendants propagating from an origin.
Severing connection supplies the destructive treatment of generated relations.
Affiliation to a people supplies the relation that should be joined.
The later pairing of messengers with spouses repeats the family frame.
Repeated dispersal from a small origin reinforces lineage propagation.

structural_cues: Spouses and descendants recur in 13:23 and 13:38, while 13:25 places cutting and joining in direct opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb/kinship polysemy, family sequences, propagation, and join/cut relations; I infer that gestation initiates accountable social bonds. The alternative is that 13:25 concerns covenantal ties generally rather than womb-derived kinship specifically.

changed_reading.before: The womb’s changes concern the developing body alone.
changed_reading.after: Measured womb change is also the beginning of lineage and of social bonds that can later be maintained or severed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pair of decrease and increase is recast as active apportionment: extension and surplus stand opposite constriction, while provision is a divided allotment rather than an inert quantity.

activation_trace.role: Decrease supplies contraction on the focus side.
Increase supplies expansion on the focus side.
Bounded amount initially reads as neutral measurement.
Expansion, increase, and surplus supply active widening.
Divided allotment makes widening and narrowing distributive acts.
Narrowing to a small measure activates the constrictive force within q-d-r.

structural_cues: In 13:26 the coordinated verbs place expansion directly against q-d-r constriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus decrease/increase and a later expand/constrict pair; I infer one modulation grammar. The alternative is that provision and gestation merely share quantitative vocabulary without a common causal operation.

changed_reading.before: Measure neutrally reports how much is present.
changed_reading.after: Measure can name active regulation through alternating enlargement and constriction, while still preserving exact quantity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The decrement/increment ledger gains two levels: terms are inscribed, changing entries can lose their trace or be fixed, and an encompassing source remains present with God. Exact knowledge is compatible with tracked revision rather than only a frozen state.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative estimation supplies ordered registration rather than bare magnitude.
Presence with God anchors the focus register at its source.
A bounded term supplies the unit entered in the register.
Inscription establishing a decree supplies the recorded layer.
Erasure of a trace supplies subtraction or revision within the record.
Continuance and stability supply the retained counterpart to erasure.
Repeated presence with God links this source explicitly back to focus wording.
Origin, gatherer, and reference point supply the stable source behind revisions.
The repeated authoritative inscription identifies the source as a record.

structural_cues: The phrase ‘with Him’ recurs in 13:39, where erase/confirm is immediately followed by the mother of the book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, erasure, stabilization, repeated presence, and an originating reference; I infer a changing-state register grounded in a stable source. A live alternative is that the record language concerns decrees generally and only analogically illuminates womb change.

changed_reading.before: Divine measure is a single fixed prenatal datum.
changed_reading.after: Divine measure can include a fully known revision history of prenatal decrease and increase, held against an authoritative source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a torrent’s sorting of foam and useful matter onto gestational change. It remains anchored in the focus decrease/increase/measure triad and in 13:17’s measured carrying, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not an embryological claim.

activation_trace.role: Loss and reduction provide the focus-side subtraction.
Growth and addition provide the focus-side surplus.
Floating foam supplies transient excess separated by flow.
Increase and rising make the excess visibly ascend.
Departure supplies disappearance of the transient fraction.
Discarded matter supplies expulsion rather than simple shrinkage.
Benefit distinguishes retained substance from discarded excess.
Stable waiting supplies retention after sorting.

changed_reading.before: Decrease and increase are neutral opposite movements in quantity.
changed_reading.after: They may also image selective processing: transient excess rises and leaves while a useful remainder is retained.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it reads territorial edge-loss back into a womb. It remains anchored by the focus’s fertile-female, womb, and decrease branches, but should be rendered only as a spatial model of bounded contraction, not as an identification of womb and land.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground opens a controlled spatial bridge from female carrier to land.
Decrease anchors contraction in the focus wording.
The anatomical womb supplies the bounded generative space.
Productive earth supplies the later bounded generative domain.
Loss of part of a thing specifies diminution rather than disappearance.
Edge and endpoint localize the loss at a boundary.
Exact ordering and firmness contain the boundary change within governance.

changed_reading.before: What the womb diminishes is an undifferentiated loss of content.
changed_reading.after: Diminution can be spatially imagined as measured contraction or loss at the edges of a bounded generative domain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets literal pregnancy shadow moral acquisition. It remains anchored in the focus branch of carrying an entrusted burden and in 13:42’s near repetition of ‘knows what … every’, but prose should preserve pregnancy as the foreground and label the ethical reading as a syntactic-branch echo.

activation_trace.role: Bearing an entrusted burden opens a second kind of hidden carrying.
Exhaustive inclusion prepares the later every-self echo.
Counting and account supply the evaluative endpoint of what is carried.
Repeated knowing discloses each self’s otherwise hidden acquisition.
Acquiring benefit supplies content accumulated by the self.
Every self reproduces the focus’s exhaustive carrier syntax.
The living self replaces the female carrier in the echoed construction.

changed_reading.before: The carried content is exclusively prenatal.
changed_reading.after: Literal gestation remains primary but also patterns how every self invisibly accumulates a burden that is known and counted.

strongest_changes: Measure shifted from a static amount to a timed trajectory and active expand/constrict modulation.
The unseen/witnessed sequence, including childbirth and postpartum branches, made the focus a passage from hidden gestation to manifest birth.
Cloud, valley, record, and kinship contexts opened hydraulic, revision-ledger, and social readings without displacing literal pregnancy.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly re-expressed the focus mechanism in other domains: one water yields different fruit, heavy carriers discharge through measured channels, records erase or stabilize entries, and womb-origin becomes kinship obligation.
remaining_uncertainties: The ecological, hydraulic, sorting, and boundary models may be analogical activation rather than intended extensions.
Q-d-r remains live as quantity, temporal allocation, active constriction, calibrated fit, and deliberative ordering.
The mercy and kinship branches of r-h-m coexist with the anatomical womb but should not erase its grammatical primacy.
